correctness.rationale: D=GP(10,3) has 20 vertices, 30 edges and 60 perfect matchings; deleting one matching yields 36 complementary (10,10) 2-factors and 24 Hamiltonian 20-cycles, so quotient states (36×2+24)/3=32. An independently written exhaustive perfect-matching recursion produced all 60, and a distinct direct edge-color backtracker fixing global S3 at a vertex produced exactly 32 colorings; both methods gave the same 32 states. Exhaustive switching of each bichromatic connected cycle generated 36 undirected Kempe moves, one component on 20 states of degree three and six isolated edges, with exactly 20 profiles of three (10,10) unions and 12 profiles of one (10,10) plus two Hamiltonian unions. Independent NetworkX graph isomorphism and full distance computation identified the twenty-state component with the original D, distance profile (1,3,6,6,3,1). The actual certificate.json and the two source exhaustive verifier scripts were inspected; finite exhaustive certificate, unlike finite sampling, covers the complete specified quotient space.
